CustomField.description: Start of the qualification period (Jan 1 or Jul 1) for this attempt.
CustomField.formula: IF( MONTH( BLANKVALUE(Attempt_Date__c, FIR_Qualification_Form__r.Test_Date__c) ) <= 6, DATE( YEAR( BLANKVALUE(Attempt_Date__c, FIR_Qualification_Form__r.Test_Date__c) ), 1, 1), DATE( YEAR( BLANKVALUE(Attempt_Date__c, FIR_Qualification_Form__r.Test_Date__c) ), 7, 1) )
CustomField.label: Period Start
